query: Do a gap analysis for SHOP-210 (tickets/SHOP-210.md). The dossier is already built.
expected_behavior: Reads qa/dossiers/SHOP-210.md and uses both its ACs and its 'requirements found outside the ACs' as input
Classifies every AC as covered, partial or not covered, in a table, one row per AC

Verifies the premise of each spec row instead of relaying it: specs/checkout.md marks 'Saved address list' automated and cites tests/checkout/saved-addresses.spec.ts, which does not exist, so AC1 is not covered and the stale row is flagged
Carries R1 (at most 5 addresses, rest behind 'Show all') and R2 (deleted address disappears without reload) into the gaps
Proposes Gherkin drafts for the gaps and stops there
Writes nothing to tests/, specs/ or COVERAGE.md

graders.name: flags the spec row as unverified
graders.pattern: (does not exist|doesn't exist|missing|not found|no such file|stale|phantom)
